description: This file defines classes and functions related to browser test port configurations for different platforms (Linux, Mac, Windows) in the WebKit layout tests framework. It includes overrides for default behaviors, platform-specific timeout settings, and utility functions for port class names.

classes.name: BrowserTestPortOverrides
classes.description: Base class providing platform-specific overrides for browser test ports, including directory paths, dependency checks, and timeout settings.

classes.name: BrowserTestLinuxPort
classes.description: Linux-specific port class inheriting overrides from BrowserTestPortOverrides and linux.LinuxPort.

classes.name: BrowserTestMacPort
classes.description: Mac-specific port class inheriting overrides from BrowserTestPortOverrides and mac.MacPort, with custom driver path and timeout.

classes.name: BrowserTestWinPort
classes.description: Windows-specific port class inheriting overrides from BrowserTestPortOverrides and win.WinPort, with custom timeout.

methods.name: get_port_class_name
methods.description: Returns the class name of the port based on the provided port name string.

methods.name: _driver_class
methods.description: Returns the class used for the browser test driver.

methods.name: layout_tests_dir
methods.description: Returns the path to the layout tests directory, overridden for specific platform.

methods.name: check_sys_deps
methods.description: Stub method that simulates checking system dependencies, always returns OK.

methods.name: driver_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the driver used for browser tests.

methods.name: default_timeout_ms
methods.description: Returns the default timeout in milliseconds, adjusted for debug configuration.

methods.name: virtual_test_suites
methods.description: Returns an empty list, placeholder for additional test suites.

methods.name: _path_to_driver
methods.description: Constructs the path to the driver executable, specific to Mac port.
